recognize_zh: 這是流式細胞儀 CD4（y 軸）對 CD8（x 軸）點圖，已圈選 CD3+ T 細胞：CD8+ 75.24%、CD4+ 17.00%，CD4/CD8 比例倒置約 1:4.4，另有 7.46% CD4-/CD8- 雙陰性 T 細胞，後者多為 γδ T 細胞。
features: Two-parameter dot plot gated on CD3+ events: CD4-APC750 versus CD8-ECD
CD4-CD8+ T cells (green, lower right) 75.24%, giving an inverted CD4:CD8 ratio of about 0.23
CD4-CD8- double-negative T cells (light blue, lower left) 7.46%, mildly increased
CD4+CD8+ double-positive events (dark blue, upper right) negligible at 0.31%
describe_en: Flow cytometric dot plot gated on CD3-positive T cells displays CD4 versus CD8 expression. CD8-positive T cells predominate (75.24%) over CD4-positive T cells (17.00%), yielding a markedly inverted CD4:CD8 ratio of approximately 1:4.4. A distinct CD4/CD8 double-negative T-cell population comprises 7.46% of T cells, and double-positive T cells are negligible (0.31%). The double-negative population is most often TCR gamma/delta T cells, which typically express brighter CD3 and dimmer CD5; confirmation requires TCR gamma/delta staining, and clonality cannot be determined from this plot alone.

ddx.dx: Reactive CD8 T-cell expansion (e.g. viral infection, HIV)
ddx.vs: Shows an inverted ratio with CD8 T cells of normal antigen intensity and preserved CD5/CD7, without a discrete aberrant population.
CD8+ T cells are clonal, often CD57+ with dim or lost CD5/CD7, requiring TRBC1 or TCR gene rearrangement studies to confirm.

ddx.dx: Hepatosplenic T-cell lymphoma / gamma-delta T-cell lymphoma
ddx.vs: Double-negative TCR gamma/delta+ cells are clonal and phenotypically aberrant (e.g. CD5 loss, CD56+), with clinical hepatosplenomegaly, rather than a small polyclonal population.
